engagement_background.objective: APDerm engaged Treya Partners to unlock procurement cost savings and leverage its enterprise-wide purchasing power after rapid, acquisition-driven growth left the organization with limited spend visibility, fragmented supplier relationships, and escalating costs during the pandemic.
engagement_background.scope_summary: Over two phases Treya addressed approximately $6.3 million in annual indirect spend across 10+ categories. Phase 2 alone targeted $3.5 million in spend covering Billing Services, Janitorial, IT Managed Services, Laundry/Linen, Non-IT Temp Labor, Copiers/Print, and Uniforms, while Waste Management was later removed due to a recent contract and low savings potential.
constraints_challenges: Purchasing was decentralized across dozens of clinic locations acquired over time, making stakeholder alignment and data collection difficult.
Fragmented supplier base with multiple overlapping contracts limited volume leverage and complicated baseline development.
Limited historical spend visibility and inconsistent vendor naming in AP data required extensive cleansing before analysis.
Inflationary market and pandemic-related supply chain disruptions put upward pressure on pricing and vendor lead times.
Aggressive private-equity value-creation timeline necessitated simultaneous sourcing waves and rapid implementation.

procurement_environment.data_availability: AP invoice data from the accounting system was available and exported to Excel; contract files and detailed usage data had to be gathered manually from local sites and suppliers.
procurement_environment.data_quality_notes: Spend data contained duplicate or inconsistent vendor names and lacked a centralized contract repository, resulting in limited initial spend visibility.

extraction_notes: Operating model explicitly described as decentralized in the case study.
Procurement maturity classified as low due to statements about lack of spend visibility and unleveraged purchasing power.
Scope details consolidated from spend analysis workbook and kickoff materials; Waste Management exclusion captured from June 29, 2022 update.
